author: Chris Schommer
title: David Sandlin solid on mound in rout of Royals
desc: David Sandlin allowed one earned run on three hits and three walks while striking out six over six innings in Friday's 22-1 win over the Royals.
impact: Sandlin has provided mixed results on the mound, allowing three earned runs or more in two of his last four trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of the more dismal options in the White Sox rotation for manager Will Venable, posting a 6.05 ERA and 1.29 WHIP with a 2-1 record and 9.3 K/9 ratio across four appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jacob Misiorowski battles control in win over Cubs
desc: Jacob Misiorowski allowed one earned run on two hits and four walks while striking out eight over six innings in Friday's 6-2 win over the Cubs.
impact: Misiorowski continues a strong stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less while striking out seven or more in each of his last 10 trips to the mound. The right-hander remains an elite starting option in all formats for fantasy managers, carrying a 1.45 ERA and 0.77 WHIP with a 9-3 record and 13.3 K/9 ratio across 16 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: William Contreras goes yard in win over Cubs
desc: William Contreras went 2-for-3 in Friday's 6-2 win over the Cubs with a two-run home run and one walk.
impact: Contreras has heated back up at the plate, recording hits in five of his last six contests. The 28-year-old offers manager Pat Murphy one of the more dynamic bats in the Brewers lineup, batting .306 with nine home runs, 50 RBI, 46 runs scored, and one stolen base across 75 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Cooper Pratt doubles, steals base in win over Cubs
desc: Cooper Pratt went 1-for-2 in a win over the Cubs with a double, two runs scored, two walks, and one stolen base.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Hunter Goodman drives in three in loss to Twins
desc: Hunter Goodman went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Twins with a home run, one run scored, and three RBI.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jake McCarthy goes deep, doubles in loss to Twins
desc: Jake McCarthy went 3-for-5 in Friday's 9-8 loss to the Twins with a home run, a double, two runs scored, and two RBI.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Tomoyuki Sugano torched early in loss to Twins
desc: Tomoyuki Sugano allowed seven earned runs on eight hits and one walk while striking out two over five innings in Friday's loss to the Twins.
